notes.title: Report
notes.content:
Enemies activated on the map as well.
Hungry for the manual.
It will be added in the next changepack.
- the game counts a little on survival
- in reality, you eat and drink at least once a day
- who finds raw materials in the wasteland, some time escapes him. You must have patience.
- takes time to cut down a tree - try using an ax
I wanted you to figure most things out on your own. And not to pull your hand. I will deliver the little manual :)
The game is in the beginning and many things will be adjusted according to the initiative of the players.
Thanks
